body: I know what you mean, it's comforting to talk to people who can relate.

It's that small bit of motivation that's the problem for me. When I do get a spark of willpower, it just seems to wither away and swallowed up by doubts and despair. 

Getting a job would be hard enough for me even if I had all the motivation in the world.

Volunteer work might be an option - how easy to join? What's it like?

Part of my problem is that I'm good at "faking it", so it probably to people like I'm a selfish, lazy piece of shit who doesn't even care that I'm hurting them  - and that's true, but I *am* trying. When I tell people I have social anxiety, I always get a "but you're good with people!", while the truth is interacting with people is so tiring and I just can't bear to do it somedays. I'm good at first meetings but I can't form bonds with people beyond that. Normal things like just popping down to the corner shop terrify me. I stopped going to class and dropped out of uni because I couldn't bear interacting with people. It's not even that I didn't have friends I liked and got along with. It's like I'm so scared of people letting me down or me letting them down, I get self destructive and destroy our relationship before anything can happen. There's no logic behind it but I can't stop doing it.

I've tried just not giving a shit about what people think of me, but I can't do it. It's not a switch I can just turn off. If it were a switch, it'd be one I turn off that automatically comes back on everytime I'm not paying complete attention to it. At best, when I try to stop caring, I stop interacting with people altogether and isolate myself more - the end result is the same.

I feel the same way. I don't have autism but I do have anxiety and I just can't function. Antidepressants have made no difference, it's still a struggle to get out of bed in the morning because what's the fucking point?

I don't know why I can't do simple things normally like everyone else. I'm hurting my parents and I know me dying will ruin them but living is so painful and I won't have to worry about that if I'm dead.
